query: 48‑year‑old female: among ICU patients aged 43–53 with acute respiratory failure, report the 95th‑percentile vital instability index in first 48 hours. For the cohort top quartile, compare MAP<65 hypotension and tachycardia episodes, ICU LOS, and mortality versus general ICU population.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) within GROUP (ORDER BY (vital_signs_systolic_pressure - vital_signs_diastolic_pressure) / NULLIF(vital_signs_heart_rate, 0)) AS percentile_95 FROM chartevents JOIN icu_stays ON chartevents.subject_id = icu_stays.subject_id AND chartevents.hadm_id = icu_stays.hadm_id AND chartevents.stay_id = icu_stays.stay_id WHERE (icu_stays.outtime - icu_stays.intime) <= 48 AND (vital_signs_systolic_pressure - vital_signs_diastolic_pressure) / NULLIF(vital_signs_heart_rate, 0) > 0;
